metadata.title: A Covariant Screened Theory for a Dark-Energy-Tied Galaxy Law: Both Covariant Forms Are Ill-Posed Somewhere, and the Khronon Form Fails Growth, Hosted Systems and Cluster Cores (Working Note)
metadata.description:
Working note, version 1.1 (2026-10-23): an erratum to v1.0 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23585319) and the results of the v3 recompute lanes. AI-assisted research programme; not peer reviewed. kappa = 1/2 FITTED (kappa = 1/2 is fitted); the theory is not closed.

The owner's programme studies a gravity framework whose galactic law is g_N = g^2/(g + a0), a0 = kappa c sqrt(G rho_DE); its extra gravitating mass is a collisionless 'cold energy' medium, not a particle. The companion note PAPER58 found that only a screened version, with a stiffness length L*, passes both Cassini and the galactic law. This note writes that screened theory covariantly in two forms and tests both: v3, the Blanchet-Skordis Khronon with an independent spatial covector and one stiffness term gamma_L, and v4, AeST with the same term. Criteria frozen before computing, mutation controls run, every lane added in v1.1 rerun by the coordinator; both a0 footings (9.36e-11 and 1.13e-10 m/s^2) reported and never pooled.

In plain terms: the covariant candidate v3 is ill-posed wherever the khronon density is negative, at every two-body saddle and in the external-field lobes around every system, and the gamma_L screening term is what makes the instability unbounded (H4); v4 is ill-posed wherever the aether twists (I1). v3 also fails several structural tests: linear growth at the dust mass galaxies allow, a radiation era in its literal form, hosted dwarf satellites, Coma's ultra-diffuse galaxies, the Milky Way's outer slope, and cluster cores for every allowed dust mass. It passes Cassini and the planets (screened), the strong-field tests (scoped), the MeerKAT a0, isolated groups, and natively, with no knob, tidal dwarfs and DF2/DF4. What the data require of any successor is a cold component that binds in hosted systems and in clusters, and grows like dust.

(1) Erratum (M1): v3's linear growth failure is caused by Blanchet and Skordis's cap on the dust mass mu_K, not by J'(0) = -1 as v1.0 stated; at the cap J_x holds the dust better than J'(0) = 0 (sigma8 ratio 0.391 against 0.121), and 0.95 needs mu_K >= 411 h/Mpc, 27.8 times the cap. (2) Cosmology: literal v3 has no radiation era and BBN needs mu_K >= 1.84e8 h/Mpc (Q6); BS25's DBI K fixes BBN only, growth R_B = 0.26-0.32 (Q7); v4 runs away on FRW for the dust shape tried (C7). (3) Hosted systems: v3's held dust never exceeds the AQUAL phantom (theorem T1) and is weightless in a static host (T3), so hosted systems are dust-free: satellites +2.00 / +1.99 dex and Coma UDGs +1.41 dex above v3, STRUCTURAL; tidal dwarfs and DF2/DF4 a NATIVE PASS (U1); one external-field strength does not fit (T1). (4) SPARC CONDITIONAL; Milky Way K_z, tidal dwarfs and DF2/DF4 as recorded statically (P4); Milky Way outer slope SHAPE EXCLUDED (Z -4.37 / -4.62); kappa CONSISTENT, NOT DISCRIMINATING (0.499 +- 0.116 / 0.413 +- 0.096); v3 Gaia DR4 Milky-Way and ALMA readings sealed (S3). (5) Clusters fail in both forms: cores 1.68-1.85 (canonical) / 1.54-1.70 (alternative) times the law on baryons, and no allowed mu_K fixes them (F1, H2, S4). (6) Strong field PASS on all five, scoped (P3); Cassini passes in all 24 cells. (7) Lensing conditional or undecidable (S2, P2, F2). (8) Pending: the Khronon-native nonlinear production run (L1) is in progress, no result given. Gaia DR4 is the sealed decisive test of screening: gamma_v - 1 = 8.1e-6 screened against about 1.17 unscreened.

Changes in v1.1: the M1 erratum; new lanes Q6, Q7, C7 (milestone 5), H4, I1, P3, P4, S1, U1, T1, S2, P2, S3, S4, P1, J1, K1, M2; superseded v1.0 statements (the satellites' +0.89 dex as the screened gap, 'v4 is the better-surviving candidate', 'only tensor modes propagate', F2's tolerated field, E6's chemistry premise); v1.0's pending native CMB and cosmic-shear items resolved (native spectra exist; CFG960 was scored on the retired settling engine, not v3); title and abstract rewritten. kappa, L* and the dust abundance are fitted, not derived. No result here is evidence for the framework over its rivals.

Companion notes: PAPER58 v1.1 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23579379), PAPER57 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23532885), PAPER49 v1.2 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23533323). AI assistance: Anthropic's Claude (analysis lanes, review, drafting).
